title: English Practice Quiz 0970
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A passenger should stand behind the safety line while waiting for ___.
options: a traffic light to change at home
questions.explanation: Safety lines help keep passengers away from the platform edge.

questions.question: A ticket inspector may ask passengers to show their ___.
questions.explanation: A travel ticket is evidence that the passenger has paid or is authorised to travel.

questions.question: When a train is crowded, it is considerate to ___.
options: allow passengers to get off before boarding
questions.explanation: Letting passengers exit first makes boarding safer and easier.

questions.question: A 'connecting service' is a service that ___.
options: links with another part of a journey
questions.explanation: A connecting service helps passengers continue their journey.

questions.question: If you miss your stop, you should ___.
options: get off at a safe designated stop and check the return route
ask the driver to reverse in traffic
questions.explanation: Use designated stops and safe travel arrangements.

questions.question: A reserved seat is intended for ___.
options: the passenger or group it is allocated to
anyone who arrives first in every case
questions.explanation: Reserved seating is allocated according to the ticket or service rules.

questions.question: If you see an unattended suspicious item, you should ___.
options: avoid touching it and inform transport staff or authorities
open it to identify the owner
post a close-up photo with location details
questions.explanation: Do not handle suspicious items; report them to responsible personnel.

questions.question: A 'fare' is the amount paid for ___.
questions.explanation: Fare means the price charged for a journey.

questions.question: Offering a seat to a person who needs it more is an example of ___.
questions.explanation: Offering a seat can show consideration for another passenger.
